events.title: US-Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran continues to escalate, with potential implications for global oil prices and geopolitical stability. The situation remains volatile, with multiple scenarios possible. The US has shown military strength, but also faces challenges in its geopolitical power.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The conflict escalation could lead to increased oil prices, benefiting oil-related stocks, but also poses risks to the global economy, potentially affecting the S&P 500. A short position in oil-related ETFs could be profitable if the conflict leads to decreased oil demand.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil price movements and conflict developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or the conflict de-escalates
